visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with pink-tinged braids and a black t-shirt sits on a yellow sofa, holding two small brown otter plushies. The lighting is bright and indoor. (2) Scene shifts to an office where the same woman stands, holding a larger otter plushie like a microphone, interviewing a seated female colleague with long black hair. (3) The camera cuts to various quick interviews with different office staff: a man in a black t-shirt, a man in a black-and-red hoodie, and another woman in a white lab coat. The woman with braids uses the otter plush as a mic throughout. (4) A close-up shot focuses on a smartphone screen showing a food-ordering app interface with images of croissants and text. (5) The interviewer interacts with a woman sitting on a black leather sofa who is holding a white, fluffy dog. She points the otter mic toward the dog, which playfully bites it. (6) The video concludes with the main creator standing in front of a white wall, gesturing energetically while holding the otter microphone.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain and engage viewers by investigating a common linguistic habit regarding the usage of the Chinese words 'jìnrán' and 'jūrán'. The video leverages humor, cute props (otters), and social office dynamics to create a relatable short-form piece.
